abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description:
When you hit a creature with this weapon and you aren't wielding a Shield, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class until the start of your next turn. You can gain this bonus only once per turn.

In the Craftsman's custom-weapon-creation rules, this property's prerequisite is instead any Melee Weapon that doesn't have the Two-Handed property.
abilities.execution: When you hit a creature with this weapon

abilities.name: Shift
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can immediately move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
abilities.prerequisite: Melee Weapon, Light or Finesse Property
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon

abilities.name: Bludgeon
abilities.description: You can treat this weapon as a Melee weapon with the Finesse property. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, it deals Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, or 1d8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier if the weapon is wielded in two hands.
abilities.execution: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon

abilities.name: Mounted
abilities.description: You can use a Bonus Action to mount this weapon in a fixed position until the end of your turn. While mounted, this weapon can't be moved and its damage dice increase by one step (d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12, to a maximum of d12s) when the weapon is used to make a ranged attack.
abilities.execution: Bonus Action to mount the weapon in a fixed position

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with this weapon. This weapon's range is 20/60 if it were higher.
abilities.execution: Passive — applies whenever you make a ranged attack with this weapon

abilities.name: Sighted
abilities.description: Attacking at long range with this weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls. When you hit a creature with an attack using this weapon at long range, you can reroll any of the damage dice and must use the new roll.
abilities.execution: When you hit a creature with an attack using this weapon at long range

abilities.name: Tension
abilities.description: When making a Ranged attack with this weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.
abilities.execution: When making a Ranged attack with this weapon

abilities.name: Twinshot
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with a ranged attack roll using this weapon, you can make a ranged attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 10 feet of the first that is also within the weapon's range. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with a ranged attack roll using this weapon

abilities.name: Explode
abilities.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your ranged attacks with an explosion from this weapon's projectile. This explosion is a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within the weapon's normal range. Each creature within the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. You can create an explosion only once per turn.

In the Craftsman's custom-weapon-creation rules, this property's prerequisite is instead Fire Damage, Masterwork Ranged Weapon (no Craftsman level restriction).
abilities.prerequisite: Level 5+ Craftsman; Fire Damage, Ranged Weapon [Craftsman Only]
abilities.execution: When you take the Attack action, replace one ranged attack with an explosion

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: When you make an attack with this weapon, you can choose to make two attacks instead. These attacks are always made with Disadvantage, regardless of circumstance. This property is often called Automatic when added to Ranged weapons.
abilities.prerequisite: Level 5+ Craftsman; Ammunition, Finesse, Light, or Versatile Property [Craftsman Only]
abilities.execution: When you make an attack with this weapon

abilities.name: Follow-Through
abilities.description: When you take the Attack action and hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can forgo an attack later on this turn provided by the Extra Attack feature to perform a heavier swing. You deal 2d12 extra damage to that creature of the same type dealt by the weapon. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.
abilities.prerequisite: Level 5+ Craftsman; Melee Weapon, Heavy Property [Craftsman Only]
abilities.execution: When you take the Attack action and hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon

abilities.name: Jolt
abilities.description:
If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, the creature can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

In the Craftsman's custom-weapon-creation rules, this property's prerequisite is simply Lightning Damage (no Craftsman level restriction).
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it

abilities.name: Numb
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, the target can't take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action or have Advantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it

abilities.name: Crush
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has a −3 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the AC penalty doesn't exceed −3.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon

abilities.name: Daze
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon

abilities.name: Finisher
abilities.description: If you hit a creature that is Bloodied with this weapon and deal damage, you can deal an extra 1d8 damage to the target. The damage is the same type as the damage dealt by the weapon and you can only deal this extra damage once per turn.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature that is Bloodied with this weapon and deal damage

abilities.name: Puncture
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with an attack roll with this weapon and the roll is an 18–20 on the d20, you score a Critical Hit.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with an attack roll with this weapon and the roll is an 18–20

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, your next attack roll with this weapon against that creature before the end of the current turn deals an extra 1d6 damage. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon.
abilities.execution: If you hit a creature with this weapon

abilities.name: Automatic
abilities.description: When you make an attack with this weapon, you can choose to make two attacks instead. These attacks are always made with Disadvantage, regardless of circumstance. You can't replace these attacks. If this weapon has the Ammunition property, these attacks use twice the normal amount of ammunition.
abilities.execution: When you make an attack with this weapon
